title: Week in Orbit
summary: The space industry is buzzing with AI initiatives and new contracts, while budget discussions hint at a growing focus on resilience. Meanwhile, launch capabilities are expanding, though hypersonic tests remain elusive.

themes.title: AI Takes Center Stage
themes.body: Astra's commitment to AI highlights a broader trend where technology is not just a replacement but a solution to workforce shortages in aerospace. This shift could redefine operational efficiencies across the sector.

themes.title: Launch Sites on the Rise
themes.body: Vandenberg's new offerings for small and medium rockets signal a strategic move to accommodate the growing demand for diverse launch capabilities. This could attract a wider array of clients, from startups to established players.

themes.title: Budget Boost for Space Resilience
themes.body: The proposed $1.4 billion increase in the FY27 budget for space resilience indicates a serious commitment to fortifying U.S. capabilities in an increasingly contested domain. Expect to see this funding translate into more robust defense initiatives.

themes.title: Hypersonic Hiccups Continue
themes.body: The ongoing delays in hypersonic glide-vehicle tests raise questions about the pace of technological advancement in this critical area. As defense budgets swell, the pressure will mount to deliver results.
